findings.title: New non-interactive auto-detect behavior is not documented for end users
findings.problem: The ticket's acceptance criterion requires the optional --non-interactive-or-equivalent behavior to be documented, but only internal JSDoc was added in auth-validation.ts and interactive.ts -- no README, CLI --help text, or CHANGELOG entry tells CLI users/automation authors that SSO re-auth now fails fast (instead of hanging) when no TTY is attached.
findings.impact: Users relying on this behavior in CI/automation have no discoverable documentation confirming or explaining it; the ticket's documentation AC is not met.
findings.recommendation: Add a short note (e.g. in README's authentication/SSO section, or the relevant CLI --help text) describing: in a non-interactive environment (no TTY), missing/expired SSO credentials now fail fast with a clear message and non-zero exit instead of hanging.
